block.frontierhunts.steel_gong.desc: Rings when hit. At long range you hear it a moment after the shot.
block.frontierhunts.steel_popper.desc: Falls when hit and stands back up after three seconds.
block.frontierhunts.steel_deer_target.de: A broadside whitetail in steel. The painted patch is the heart and lungs.
block.frontierhunts.steel_spinner.desc: Hit the big plate and it spins over the top.
block.frontierhunts.foam_deer_target.des: Two blocks long. Scored like a 3D archery course: 12, 10, 8 (vitals), 5.
block.frontierhunts.range_marker.desc: Right-click to set the distance: 25 to 500 m. Sneak to go back.
store.frontierhunts.blurb.tracking_lamp: Blood within 20 m shows bright red, day or night
store.frontierhunts.blurb.estrus_lure: Rut only: bucks nearby may come to the wick
store.frontierhunts.blurb.coffee_thermos: Three hot cups: warm now, chill held off 5 min
store.frontierhunts.blurb.hand_warmers: Four packs, ten minutes of warmth each
store.frontierhunts.blurb.steel_gong: Rings on a hit; the sound arrives late at range
store.frontierhunts.blurb.steel_popper: Drops when hit, stands back up
store.frontierhunts.blurb.steel_spinner: Spins over the top on a hit
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.stores.count: The outfitter's counter only stocks what nobody can make: field gear from town and steel and foam targets for a range. Ammunition, batteries, scent cover and first aid are made at your benches; licences, tags and the game report are at the licence counter.
licence.frontierhunts.page.why_tokens: Reserve tokens are the reserve's money: earned from contracts, delivering meat and hides at the ranger board, and expedition work. They pay for licences, tags, stamps, ranger services, camp upgrades, and the outfitter's gear and range targets.
onboard.frontierhunts.clean.books_hint: Your Journal, Expedition journal, Field School and Assignments are along the bottom of every page. Prefer the older, fuller layout? Settings > Interface & HUD > Classic Handbook.
